title: Sweet Magnolia - Vacation Rental in Grayton Beach,FL | 30a Escapes
description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… "Sweet Magnolia", a charming retreat in Grayton Beach. This spacious home features 4 en-suites, a private heated pool, a screened-in porch with an oversized swing, and a cozy backyard fire pit. Located just a short 5-minute walk to the beach and close to Seaside, it’s perfect for families and groups seeking a tranquil yet luxurious getaway. Enjoy beach bikes, a well-equipped kitchen, and relaxing outdoor spaces for the ultimate 30A vacation experience!*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Private Pool: Escape to your personal oasis, available year-round with optional seasonal heating from September to April, complete with cozy loungers for ultimate relaxationScreened-In Porch with Swing: Relax in this charming space, perfect for cocktails, morning coffee, or family chatsBackyard Fire Pit: Gather under the stars with s’mores and stories in this cozy outdoor areaSpacious Living Areas: Open-concept design with comfortable seating, hardwood floors, and plenty of space for large groupsFully Equipped Kitchen: Features stainless steel appliances, ample cookware, and a breakfast bar for easy meal preparationFamily-Friendly Layout: Accommodates up to 13 guests comfortably with tastefully decorated interiors and 4 cozy bedrooms with en-suite bathroomsSteps to the Beach: Just a 5-10 minute walk to Grayton Beach's beautiful shorelineCommunity Charm: Nestled in Grayton Beach, just a short bike ride from the vibrant Seaside community, restaurants, and shopsBeach Bikes: Includes 6 adult bikes, perfect for exploring Grayton Beach and nearby SeasideEager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ "The screened-in porch swing was our favorite! Tastefully decorated, comfy beds, a well-maintained pool, and just a short walk to the beach." – Heather M.⭐ "Spacious yet cozy, with a perfect screened-in porch for evening cocktails. Loved the short walk to the beach and pool!" – Jo S.⭐ "Spacious and quiet with a private pool and well-stocked kitchen. Perfect for family time—pool heating highly recommended!" – Anonymous*** LIVING AREA ***Open-Concept Living Room: Features a comfortable sofa, armchairs, a large Smart TV, vaulted ceilings, and hardwood floors. Ideal for family gatherings or movie nightsScreened-In Porch: Furnished with an oversized swing, creating a cozy spot for evening cocktails or morning coffee, free from pesky insects*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Fully Equipped Kitchen: Includes stainless steel appliances, ample cookware, and a breakfast bar with seating for 4Dining Area: Features a large wooden dining table with seating for 8, perfect for family meals and game nightsOutdoor Dining: An additional dining area on the upper deck overlooking the pool, perfect for enjoying al fresco meals*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Private Pool: Surrounded by loungers and shaded seating; heating available September-AprilBackyard Fire Pit: A perfect spot to gather under the stars for s'mores and late-night conversationsGas Grill Area: Convenient for cooking fresh seafood or grilling burgers for the family*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***2nd Floor Guest Bedroom 1: Queen bed and twin-over-twin bunk bed with a private en-suite bathroom featuring a tub/shower combo2nd Floor Guest Bedroom 2: Queen bed and twin-over-twin bunk bed with a private en-suite bathroom featuring a tub/shower combo3rd Floor Primary Suite: King bed with an en-suite bathroom featuring a tub/shower combo3rd Floor Guest Bedroom 3: King bed with an additional twin bed and a private en-suite bathroom featuring a tub/shower combo*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Beach Launch Charter Fishing: Experience fishing adventures just steps from the beach, perfect for enthusiasts and first-timers alikeTurtle Reef: Discover Grayton Beach’s famous artificial reef, located less than a mile offshore, ideal for snorkeling and paddleboardingLively Nightlife: Enjoy the vibrant atmosphere with eclectic bars and Grayton Beer—a local favorite for craft brewsEccentric Art Galleries: Explore unique and colorful local galleries showcasing a mix of contemporary and coastal-inspired artGrayton Beach State Park: A haven for nature lovers, offering 200 acres of trails for hiking, biking, and bird watching, along with swimming and fishing opportunitiesYOLO Board and Eco Tours: Paddle through serene waters and rare dune lakes with guided tours highlighting the area's natural beautyRare Coastal Dune Lakes: Visit Grayton Lake and Western Lake for swimming, fishing, and boating surrounded by pristine landscapes*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentWaiver required to get access to the 6 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesPrivate Pool is heated from September 1st–April 30th.There is construction next door to this property with an unknown end date, which may result in occasional noise*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 19190STRO #: STR-019190
